appDescription.message:
❗❗IF IT DOESN’T WORK AFTER INSTALLATION – RESTART YOUR BROWSER❗❗
MaiRec automatically solves reCAPTCHA by selecting and clicking on images — the entire solution is processed by an on-device neural network directly inside the extension.

Features:
 - Solves reCAPTCHA V2 / V2 Invisible / Enterprise
 - Free and open source
 - No API key needed, no payments required
 - Neural network runs locally on CPU via ONNX WebAssembly
 - Works offline with zero cloud inference dependency
 - No registration required, works right after installation

Usage details:
 - On startup, it may pause for 5–15 seconds while initializing AI models
 - Understands English, and automatically switches reCAPTCHA to English
 - In settings, you can enable/disable the solver
 - Customizable delays between clicks and before verification
 - Optional WebSocket worker mode for distributed automation

help_local_models.message: Models run locally, no data is sent outside.

help_timeouts.message: A random 0–300 ms is added to each timeout. Dynamic reveal counts recognition time already spent.
